reason: I already cram for Corporate Finance and Micro midterms for free by stacking NotebookLM, free ChatGPT, Knowt, and our campus Zalo and Google Drive past-exam banks. Even at 49,000 VND with a paused 7-day pass, I'm not paying for a study pack when my free tools already handle the slides.
objection: I doubt a new app I just saw while scrolling will handle messy Vietnamese and English lecture or past-exam PDFs without messing up notation, and when I'm cramming 48 hours before an exam, a refund guarantee doesn't fix lost study time if the AI gets a formula step wrong.
would_change_my_mind: If I tried the free 5-question preview on a real past-exam PDF from my course and saw it handle messy Vietnamese and English math accurately right after free ChatGPT cut off my uploads.
